newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Two men appear in court over Australian explosion.
newsitem.headline: Two men appear in court over Australian explosion.

text.p: Two Australian men appeared in court on Monday, charged over an explosion that destroyed a luxury Sydney home next to the Turkish consulate-general.
No motive was given for the attack on Sunday, but police said earlier it did not appear to be politically motivated.
Thomas Vincent, 29, and Max Gibson, 25, appeared in a local Sydney court and each was charged with one count of malicious damage.
Police told the court the pair went to the vacant house on Sunday, doused several rooms with petrol and ignited the building.
A subsequent explosion destroyed the two-storey brick home in the suburb of Woolhara in the heart of Sydney's consulate district, and damaged surrounding houses.
Gibson, who was injured in the blast, appeared in court on crutches, with a cut on his face and bandaged hands.
The two men were remanded in custody to appear again in April. No pleas were entered.
